en: The image depicts a historical street scene with a bustling bazaar. There are several people in period attire, a horse-drawn carriage, and typical market activity. In the background stands a domed building with a minaret, signifying an Islamic architectural influence. The sky has a late afternoon hue. At the top of the image, the text 'Smyrne. Rue des Derviches (Bazar).' is visible, and there is a website watermark 'www.elia.org.gr' at the bottom.
